cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Ask Dad why our holiday account's empty. I'll wait by the kitchen door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come with me. You booked the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Ask whether he's angry about the price first. If he isn't, I'll come in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm calling you in if he wants the flight receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask whether he wants the total or the breakdown before you call me. The seat upgrades need a longer explanation.

mechanism: A uses its old pupil graduated questioning habits to send B ahead into a family financial conversation, delaying A own exposure until the reaction is known.
confusable: Not making B handle the entire problem: A promises to enter only after B tests specific dangerous questions.
comparison: Formal explanation plausibility versus parental anger and receipt detail.
seedUse: D128 Dad/holiday account/flights/door/upgrades; S05 coached asking strategy.
